parent.note: Mature construct, not precursor. Parent identity verified from supplied FASTA.

reaction.note: pNPL ester bond hydrolysis. Chemical state: neutral ester at pH 7. Reaction-specific water required for hydrolysis mechanism.

protected_positions.oxyanion_note: Gly34 and Ser122 form the oxyanion hole in RML; verify exact positions from structure
protected_positions.lid_residues: to be established from structure; lid domain typically residues ~100-160 in RML
protected_positions.structural_ion_features: to be established from structure (salt bridges, metal-coordinating residues)
protected_positions.note: Protected positions will be finalized after parent structure assessment. Catalytic triad S144, D203, H257 and required disulfides are mandatory.

editable_positions.strategy: Positions outside protected features, selected from parent structure, conservation and stability evidence

budgets.model_tokens: Not separately tracked in this run
budgets.wall_time: No hard ceiling; monitored per job

stability_screening.note: Primary stability endpoint; matched parent and candidate settings

catalytic_assessment.note: Reaction-specific geometry assessment for lipase hydrolysis

evaluation_protocol.note: Primary metric is the Enzymes tool thermal stability score. Higher is better. min_improvement=0 means any positive change qualifies as improvement; no significance test implied.

authorization.selection_boundary: Up to 5 non-native candidates with complete evidence
authorization.held_out_results: Published winning sequences/mutations and outcome tables are excluded
